rules.name: Data sold or shared
rules.lookFor: Language saying personal data may be sold, rented, or shared with third parties, advertisers, or "partners"

rules.name: Vague purpose
rules.lookFor: Broad phrases like "for any business purpose" or "to improve our services" with no specifics

rules.name: Indefinite retention
rules.lookFor: Data kept "as long as necessary" or with no stated deletion timeline

rules.name: Sensitive data collection
rules.lookFor: Biometric, health, precise location, financial, or children's data, or other personal identifying information

rules.name: Tracking and profiling
rules.lookFor: Cookies, pixels, fingerprinting, cross-site tracking, or building user profiles

escalation.when: the text offers no way to opt out of the tracking or profiling

rules.name: Hard to opt out or delete
rules.lookFor: No clear way to access, delete, or opt out of data collection, or a burdensome process

rules.name: One-sided policy changes
rules.lookFor: The company can change the policy without notice or consent

rules.name: AI or model training
rules.lookFor: User data or content used to train AI or machine learning models

rules.name: Cross-border transfers
rules.lookFor: Data sent to other countries without stated safeguards

rules.name: Forced or bundled consent
rules.lookFor: Consent required for unrelated features, or implied by simply using the site

rules.name: ToS: No ownership (license only)
rules.lookFor: Purchases of digital goods, software, media, or subscriptions grant only a limited, revocable license rather than ownership, or access can be removed or changed without a refund

rules.name: ToS: Forced arbitration or class-action waiver
rules.lookFor: Disputes must go to private arbitration, or the user gives up the right to sue or join a class action

rules.name: ToS: Broad license to your content
rules.lookFor: The company claims a broad, perpetual, irrevocable, or sublicensable license to content you create or upload

rules.name: ToS: Liability disclaimers
rules.lookFor: The company disclaims responsibility for data breaches, losses, or damages, or caps its liability at a trivial amount

rules.name: ToS: Auto-renewal or hard to cancel
rules.lookFor: Automatic renewals, hidden fees, no refunds, or a burdensome cancellation process
